a.xlink:title: Aggregates state, quality assessment and statistical info for an XBee link.
Lightweight state container with a change notification callback.
Computes link quality from the packet delivery ratio (PDR) and the RSSI link margin.
Primary template; only the function-signature specializations below are defined.
Statistical counters and metrics: signal strength, periods and event counters.
Holds the raw RSSI value and provides the percent conversion.
TX period tracking with smoothing and min/max capture.
